lines.text: Elisha returned to Gilgal during a famine and told his attendant to boil stew in the large pot.
One man gathered wild gourds from a vine and cut them into the stew, though no one knew them.
The men cried out that there was death in the pot, so Elisha threw salt into it.
A man from Baal-shalishah brought twenty loaves, and Elisha's servant asked how that could feed a thousand men.
Elisha said the LORD promised they would eat and have some left over, and they did.
